# `transform_values`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Transforms values in the map using the function.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
transform_values(expr, func)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `lambda_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 3.0.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 2 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- transform_values, example 1
> SELECT transform_values(map_from_arrays(array(1, 2, 3), array(1, 2, 3)), (k, v) -> v + 1);
{1:2,2:3,3:4}
```

```sql
-- transform_values, example 2
> SELECT transform_values(map_from_arrays(array(1, 2, 3), array(1, 2, 3)), (k, v) -> k + v);
{1:2,2:4,3:6}
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 3.0.0.
- Added in Krishiv 0.2.0.
